sloka: रथैरश्वैर्ध्वजैश्चित्रैः शरीरैर्हरिरक्षसाम् ।रुधिरेण च सञ्छन्ना भूमिर्भयकरी तदा ।। ६.५३.३० ।।।।
transliteration: rathairaśvairdhvajaiścitraiḥ śarīrairharirakṣasām ।rudhireṇa ca sañchannā bhūmirbhayakarī tadā ।। 6.53.30 ।।।।

translations.english: There, struck by Angada of fearful valour, the Rakshasas fell like trees smashed and heads broken.
